Definition: from a compound of G3598 and G4198; to be a wayfarer, i.e. travel:--go on a journey.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, hodoiporéō means go on a journey. It occurs just once, in Acts.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: hodoiporéō means go on a journey, and I do not stretch it further.
